title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.4 Understand Slope of a Line: Use geoboards to model slope
summary: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.4 Understand Slope of a Line: Use geoboards to model slope
body: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, section "4.4 Understand Slope of a Line", prints these objectives: "Use geoboards to model slope" "Use m = r i s e r u n to find the slope of a line from its graph" "Find the slope of horizontal and vertical lines" "Use the slope formula to find the slope of a line between two points" "Graph a line given a point and the slope" "Solve slope applications". The section text says: "When you graph linear equations, you may notice that some lines tilt up as they go from left to right and some lines tilt down. Some lines are very steep and some lines are flatter. What determines whether a line tilts up or down or if it is steep or flat?" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
